svg.title: Cutoff — Entity–Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Crow's-foot ER diagram of the 16 tables and 18 foreign keys of the Cutoff PostgreSQL schema.
svg.text: JEE Main test-taking and performance-analysis platform · PostgreSQL schema “cutoff” · 16 tables · 65 columns · 18 foreign keys

g.text: Primary key — every column of a composite key is marked
Foreign key — every column of a composite foreign key is marked
Unique constraint — composite sets are listed under the table
Partial unique index (attempts: one IN_PROGRESS attempt per student and paper)
Nullable column — every unmarked column is NOT NULL
Exactly one — parent side; every FK column is NOT NULL
Zero or one — child whose key is the FK itself
Pill on a connector = foreign-key column(s); one connector per composite FK.
Bracket on a left/right table edge = the column rows the connector uses.
